t: A 45 minute card lesson where groups refine and test a classification algorithm.
steps: Find the Machine Learning Unplugged lesson on The Tech Interactive site.
Download the lesson plan PDF and the answer key.
Print one set of Data Set Cards for each group of 3 to 4.
Keep the Part 2 cards aside until later.
Read the lesson plan and the answer key.
Decide whether to use the optional Teachable Machine section.
